work.title: Étude in G♭ major, Op. 25 No. 9 (“Butterfly”)

version.note: No modern performing edition is established; the source audio is not locally edited or concatenated.

performers.note: The original Symposium track list identifies the two études on Odeon 76563, matrix xxB 5731, with the broad date 1912/3. Internet Archive narrows the recording to March 1913; that month is not independently corroborated. The compilation dates from 1993, not the performance.

date.note: Primary Symposium track list: 1912/3. Internet Archive description: March 1913. The broader primary date is retained; neither an exact session day nor an exact first-release day is established.

recording.value: Territorial: EU public domain under the pre-1963 publication rule, on the documented original commercial Odeon 76563 carrier chronology (1912–13). US publication status is not established.
recording.note: Programme rule 3, conservatively rather than a US first-publication finding. The primary Symposium discography identifies the original commercial issue 76563 and matrix xxB 5731 in its 1912/3 chronology, corroborated by the Archive description. The source rights year 1913 is the upper end of that broad original-carrier chronology, not a verified exact first-release year. The 1993 compilation date is separate. The uploader’s Public Domain Mark is supplementary, not treated as an independent rights-owner release; no NC licence appears in the item metadata.

rights.creditLine: Chopin, Étude Op. 25 No. 9; Eugen d’Albert, piano, 1912–13. Original commercial Odeon 76563, matrix xxB 5731; transfer via Symposium 1146 and Internet Archive. Territorial EU public-domain basis; US publication status not established.
